text:
amanda: customer reports AWS Accelerator credits claimed yesterday but balance shows 0 and Billing > Credits page has no entry. account acct-8592, aws order 98765-accel. they pasted partner confirmation screenshot.

jon: thanks — can you confirm whether this is a marketplace entitlement or an accelerator grant? any marketplace order id or entitlement id from the partner portal?

amanda: partner portal shows `ENT-ACCEL-98765` and says 'credits applied'. customer says they clicked Redeem on the AWS console.

mike: pulling webhook logs for acct-8592 now. if this was a marketplace entitlement, we expect a POST to /webhooks/entitlements with `order_id` and `licensee` fields.

support-bot: log search result: 2024-03-07T16:12:03Z POST /webhooks/entitlements 200 processed? false payload_order: 98765 error: signature_mismatch

jon: aha — signature_mismatch indicates our verification rejected the partner payload. possible causes: rotated signing key, or payload truncated. @sarah can you check partner key rotation history for AWS accelerator integrator?

sarah: checked — partner rotated keys on 2024-03-06 but we didn't pull latest via the key-sync job due to a retry failure. key-sync job shows 500 at 2024-03-06T03:05:12Z. looks like the webhook validated against old key -> signature_mismatch.

amanda: is the entitlement lost or just unprocessed? customer is on an onboarding call, they need credits asap.

mike: entitlement is in partner tracker (ENT-ACCEL-98765) but our internal entitlement queue has an entry with status `failed:signature_mismatch` and no ledger write. we can manually requeue after validating payload. steps: 1) fetch original webhook payload from logs 2) verify signature using new key 3) run `POST /internal/entitlement/requeue` or use admin tool.

jon: mike, can you run the requeue now and then trigger a ledger reconciliation for acct-8592? also record repro steps.

mike: doing now. command I used: ```
# fetch log
curl -s https://logs.internal/api/logs/entitlements?order=98765 > /tmp/98765.json
# requeue
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d @/tmp/98765.json https://admin.internal/api/entitlements/requeue
# reconcile ledger
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://billing.internal/api/reconcile?account=acct-8592
```

support-bot: requeue accepted, job 5467 created. reconcile job 2219 queued.

amanda: relayed to customer that we're applying credits and doing manual reconcile, ETA ~30m.

sarah: root cause: key-sync job failed to refresh partner public key after partner rotation. short-term fix applied: manually pulled key and retried webhook reprocessing.

jon: long-term action item: add alert on key-sync failures and automatic re-fetch on webhook signature_mismatch errors. created ticket INF-2143 and assigned to eng-ops.

mike: customers' ledger now shows +$10k accelerator credits for acct-8592, customer confirmed on call. closing the thread but leaving follow-ups. :white_check_mark:

amanda: thanks team! I'll send a short note to sales and the partner to confirm key rotation schedule and ask them to notify us in future. :+1:
